title: First playable prototype
notes: Original economy, research, infantry movement and simple combat. Separate save slot.

title: Council decisions and recovery
notes: Implement–Decide–Results, settlement votes, treaty renewals, shields, highlights, and campaign checkpoints.

title: Resources and trade
notes: Timber, stone, iron, production recipes, storage, accepted trade agreements and conserved cargo.

title: Regiments and supply
notes: Mixed troops, transfers, supply routes, depots, forts, and simultaneous multi-army skirmish/melee combat.

title: Discoveries and education
notes: Twelve illustrated research achievements, funded education and learning, and saved progress in every research field.

title: Five resources and kingdom goals
notes: Money, food, wood, metal and cloth; four shared achievements with alternative development routes; visual progress and compatible old-save migration.

title: Campaign checks and recovery
notes: Validated phase calculations, old-save download, replacement checkpoints, imported diplomacy, building explanations, teacher/GitHub guide and 100-turn achievement tests.

title: Active research and living settlements
notes: Resource-consuming discoveries and six local R&D projects, Economy development allowances, named starter towns, happiness-driven migration, settlement/regiment renaming, and population map views.

title: Choices and consequences
notes: Visual food allocation and portion plans; research budgets split across three fields; six school curricula; service, work and community-support laws; resource-funded conscription; happiness and unrest; reproducible helpful and difficult social/natural events. Updated dashboards and teacher guide. Includes real v0.8 migration, conservation, policy, event, 50-turn and browser checks. Earlier releases remain unchanged.

title: Whole regiments and larger territories
notes: Four teacher phases, 100-health unit tokens, RPS advantages, captured-land income, researched movement, mutual alliances, simultaneous country-target combat, retreats and pursuit. Detailed v0.9 remains available with separate saves.

title: Neutral artillery regiments
notes: Adds recruitable 100-health artillery with neutral matchups against every type. Cavalry keeps its existing advantages. City-capture bonuses are reserved for future city mechanics; current regiment saves remain compatible.

title: Economy allocations and training
notes: Mixed-biome production and mineral deposits; live Economy allocations to Military, Research or Treasury; deliveries after the full round; recruitment at existing controlled settlements; recruits train one round and defend at half strength. Earlier regiment saves migrate without creating resources.

title: Food and happiness
notes: Economists feed territories during retreat. Happiness changes production, captured land starts at zero happiness, and military food shortages increase incoming damage next round.

title: Settlements and siege defenses
notes: Click a territory to build five settlement levels and three fortification tiers. Production and food needs grow; artillery helps overcome persistent defenses. Capture destroys forts and removes two settlement levels.

title: Shared capture agreements
notes: Joint captors choose a settlement owner unanimously. Disagreement destroys the settlement, leaves unclaimed ruins and withdraws all occupying regiments one adjacent territory.

title: Research, city actions and trade
notes: Adds national discoveries, accepted knowledge sharing, cooperative research, active city facilities, negotiated resource trades, geographic specialties and material-based military equipment.

title: Always-open departmental objectives
notes: Nine separate department objectives, flexible peaceful and mixed victories, shared round-end winners, persistent progress and tested resource-funded balance.

title: Attacks disrupt trade and joint research
notes: Bilateral attacks and sieges cancel pending exchanges and research cooperation, with clear warnings and recovery after a full quiet round.

title: Drag troop orders and happiness heat map
notes: Military drag orders respect movement limits, preview routes and preserve simultaneous resolution. Happiness now runs from dark red to bright blue.

title: Student site and phase walkthrough
notes: Separate student entry, read-only role and phase preview, shared classroom screens, happiness map and server-validated troop orders. Live student PINs await Supabase provisioning.

title: Connected student classrooms
notes: Supabase classroom service, private PIN sessions and teacher email-link sign-in. First live authenticated classroom verification pending.

title: Fresh classroom connection
notes: Version classroom sign-in assets so returning preview visitors load the live connection. Clarify teacher email-link steps.

title: Resource pictures and map
notes: Large labeled allocation icons, bolder boxes, compact trade icons and a resource map with per-round production popovers and material filters.

title: Department resource cards
notes: Four rounded resource cards for Military and R&D with available balances and live spending totals.

title: Illustrated troops
notes: Separate troop pictures on Military recruitment cards and regiment controls, with material costs.

title: Colored settlement stages
notes: Five ordered settlement pictures with red, orange, yellow, green and blue outlines, scaled map markers and an illustrated upgrade path.
